main_text.p: רזב ארזוב Ch. Securis, bipennis: vel Malleus, juxta alios. Plur. ארזובין, 1.Reg.6.7.
מרזבא מרזב Ch. Canalis, Tubus, per quem aquae emittuntur. Plur. מרזביא, מרזבין.

רזח מרזחא Ch. Curator, designator funebris, juxta quosdam, ut Hebr. מרזח, Jer.16.5. alii, Domum convivii sc. funebris, domum luctus explicant. Plural. מרזחין Amos 6.7. Regia hic transtulerunt Gaudia. Cum Aff. ואכלו עמא במרזחיהון Et comedunt populus in domo convivii ipsorum, Num.25.2. in Jon.
רזף ארזפתא Ch. Malleus, Judic.4.21. Idē quod ארזוב. מרזופא Ch. Idem. Plur. מרזופין, Psal.74.6.
רחב רחוב, רחובא רחובין Ch. Platea. Plural. רחوביא Amos 5.16.
רחל רחלא Ch. Ovis. Plur. רחלי, רחלין Oves. Deinde ponitur pro Hebraeo צאן רחלין Currus camerati, tecti, Jesa.66.20.

רחם Ch. & Syr. Amavit, dilexit, intime proprie, ex intimis animi visceribus: Misereri, parcere, Clementem, misericorde, gratiosum esse, clementia uti. Pahel רחם Idem. Ithpeh. אתרחם, Syr. Misereri, misericordia commoveri: Misericordiam consequi: Amari, diligi.

רחים רחמא Ch. & Syr. Amatus, dilectus, charus: Item Substantive Amor, dilectio: ברחים Cum dilectione, Cantic.7.7. Misericordia, Eccles.11.8. Plural. רחימין. Foemin. רחימתא, רחימתא Dilectio. Plur. רחימן.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldee words are transcribed as closely as the scan allows; several Syriac forms are only approximate and may contain errors. The Hebrew pointing is partly illegible at the small scan size.
